## What changed?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Kickoff

Before coding, complete these four parts here or in a task file linked here.
State "not applicable" when there is no agent-task issue.

- Goal restated: describe the goal and user-visible outcome in your own words.
- Expected files: list the files you expect to touch.
- Acceptance check: describe how you will verify the outcome.
- Issue link: link the agent-task issue.

The issue author's form entry is not the agent's kickoff.
Reviewer verification: confirm the kickoff was recorded before coding and its goal and user-visible outcome match the issue. An absent or mismatched kickoff blocks readiness.

## How was it tested?

List checks and synthetic evidence, including any limitations.

- [ ] Privacy: synthetic data only; no real case material or private deployment details.
- [ ] Needs hosted review? See the [review policy](../docs/QUALITY_GATES.md#review-policy).
